title: cmux notify on a workspace the window does not show marks it unread and moves it to the top; one on the shown workspace moves nothing (cx-sv425)
preconditions: a fresh launch: one window, one workspace, one terminal tab
notifications.attention.moveToTop and sidebar.workspaceRow.notification at their defaults (on and off)

steps.note: the scenario of scripts/cmux-next/sidebar-notification-e2e.py (kept); the case posts through the person's `cmux notify`, the script through the daemon socket
topology/focus/workspace is the public id of the workspace the window shows (the launch's)

expect.noReceiptReason: a setup step: the case checks the notification, not its setup

steps.note: a script caller's workspace is filed in the window without being shown (WindowManager.claimNew); created/0 is its public ws_ id

expect.noReceiptReason: a setup step: the case checks the notification, not its setup
a setup step: the case checks the notification, not its setup

steps.note: with the default top placement notif-a is now the lowest new row and not shown: a notification there must move it up

expect.noReceiptReason: a daemon notification (notification.create), not an app action; its unread mark and the row's move are its result

steps.note: NotificationCenterService.moveToTop places notif-a first among the loose rows, as Move Workspace to Top does

expect.noReceiptReason: a daemon notification (notification.create), not an app action; that nothing moves is its result

steps.note: a notification for the workspace a window shows moves nothing (moveToTop skips it)

invariants: notifications at notified lists notif-a's workspace with unread 1 and the badge grew by 1; focus and layout equal those at placed (a notification never changes what the window shows)
focus and layout at notified-shown equal those at notified
every mutation has one receipt or one typed error (I1)
ids stay stable unless the step created or closed them (I2)
teardown: quit the tagged app the run started
verify its debug socket is gone
untested: the move to the top row, which is the cited fix: it is a sidebar placement (SidebarBridge reorder), not the daemon's workspace order the topology lists, and the sidebar facet (p15-oracle-036) has no provider on the base; once it lands, the notified and notified-shown snapshots add `sidebar` and the case catches the parent
the row staying one line without the notification text (debug.sidebar_rows detail): the sidebar facet's rows have no detail field
the hover card's notification text: no facet reads a hover card's body
